WITH 
-- 1998 quarterly wages for Allegheny County
wages_1998 AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries) as avg_wkly_wage
    FROM (
        SELECT avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.1998_q1` WHERE geoid = '42003'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.1998_q2` WHERE geoid = '42003'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.1998_q3` WHERE geoid = '42003'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.1998_q4` WHERE geoid = '42003'
    )
),
-- 2017 quarterly wages for Allegheny County
wages_2017 AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries) as avg_wkly_wage
    FROM (
        SELECT avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2017_q1` WHERE geoid = '42003'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2017_q2` WHERE geoid = '42003'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2017_q3` WHERE geoid = '42003'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT avg_wkly_wage_10_total_all_industries FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2017_q4` WHERE geoid = '42003'
    )
),
-- Pittsburgh CPI for 1998 and 2017
cpi_data AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        AVG(value) as avg_cpi
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpi_u` 
    WHERE area_name = 'Pittsburgh, PA' 
      AND item_name = 'All items'
      AND series_id = 'CUUSA104SA0'
      AND year IN (1998, 2017)
    GROUP BY year
)
SELECT 
    ROUND((w2017.avg_wkly_wage - w1998.avg_wkly_wage) / w1998.avg_wkly_wage * 100, 2) as wage_growth_pct,
    ROUND((c2017.avg_cpi - c1998.avg_cpi) / c1998.avg_cpi * 100, 2) as cpi_growth_pct,
    w1998.avg_wkly_wage as avg_wkly_wage_1998,
    w2017.avg_wkly_wage as avg_wkly_wage_2017,
    c1998.avg_cpi as avg_cpi_1998,
    c2017.avg_cpi as avg_cpi_2017
FROM wages_1998 w1998, wages_2017 w2017, cpi_data c1998, cpi_data c2017
WHERE c1998.year = 1998 AND c2017.year = 2017
